headline: Software Engineer / SRE — AWS — Kubernetes — Terraform — Platform Engineering
summary: Software Engineer / SRE with experience operating production-grade, globally distributed AWS and Kubernetes platforms supporting a large-scale CPaaS environment. Hands-on with Amazon EKS, Terraform/Terragrunt, Helm, ArgoCD/GitOps, Gloo Gateway, AWS networking and security, observability, autoscaling, incident response, and infrastructure reliability. Experienced in operating 14+ production EKS clusters across 7 AWS regions and 280+ nodes, leading platform upgrades and security initiatives, operating Kubernetes-based API gateway infrastructure, standardizing multi-account infrastructure, and improving reliability, operational efficiency, and cloud resource utilization.

workExperience.title: Software Engineer I
highlights: Owned 14+ production EKS clusters spanning 7 AWS regions and 280+ nodes supporting a globally distributed CPaaS platform, leading quarterly platform upgrades across EKS versions, node AMIs, CSI drivers, load balancer controllers, autoscaling, certificate management, and secrets management while maintaining zero customer-facing downtime.

Worked as part of the Gateway Engineering team responsible for operating the Kubernetes-based API gateway layer, managing production Gloo Gateway Proxy, RateLimit, and ExtAuth pods across multi-region EKS clusters and troubleshooting gateway traffic, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and upstream connectivity issues.

Led production incident investigation and RCA across Kubernetes, gateway, networking, authentication, logging, and deployment systems, tracing failures across infrastructure and application layers, driving root-cause remediation, and improving platform reliability and operational resilience.

Managed multi-region AWS networking and security infrastructure across 7 regions, including AWS WAF, Global Accelerator, ALB, Route 53, and Shield Advanced; built centralized S3/Athena log analytics for WAF, ALB, and Global Accelerator traffic across Development, QA, and Production environments.

Managed and standardized Terraform/Terragrunt infrastructure across 13+ projects, multiple AWS accounts, and environments, migrating teams toward reusable infrastructure modules, eliminating IaC anti-patterns, and reducing configuration drift through Atlantis-based CI/CD workflows.

Drove security and compliance initiatives including vendor CVE remediation, mandatory production security rollouts, and regulatory audit logging across 21 GitOps instances, coordinating infrastructure changes while maintaining production availability.

Delivered Kubernetes cost attribution across environments by integrating clusters with the organization's FinOps platform using custom Helm automation and Terraform-based regional configuration; improved resource efficiency through utilization-driven rightsizing and migration to better-suited AWS node types.

Standardized operational practices through production runbooks, investigation queries, and internal engineering training, enabling more consistent troubleshooting and faster incident response across the wider engineering team.
Owned the platform observability ecosystem across Kubernetes, applications, and AWS infrastructure, covering metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational visibility.

Designed and maintained the metrics and alerting platform using Prometheus-style scraping, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, and Alertmanager, integrated with Slack and OpsGenie; established 15+ production P1–P3 alerts covering authentication, Kubernetes health, API Gateway traffic, load balancers, and autoscaling systems.
Maintained centralized logging using Fluent Bit, S3, OpenSearch, and Kibana, providing end-to-end visibility across application, Kubernetes, and AWS infrastructure layers.

Developed 7+ Grafana dashboards and CloudWatch-integrated views for Kubernetes, ALB, WAF, Global Accelerator, authentication, and platform health, mapping operational alerts directly to dashboards for faster incident triage.

standardAnswers.whyHireMe: I have hands-on experience running 14+ production EKS clusters across 7 AWS regions with 280+ nodes, managing zero-downtime upgrades, Gloo API Gateway, GitOps via ArgoCD, and automated IaC with Terraform/Terragrunt. I bring solid SRE incident response discipline and deep AWS observability expertise.
